messages.subject: Longitudinal SEM in lavaan -- livestreamed seminar (last chance!)
parts:
Hi everyone
Last chance to sign up for the upcoming Longitudinal SEM in R seminar sponsored by Instats, which is a 2-day seminar introducing longitudinal data models in lavaan using SEM, including latent growth models (i.e., latent curve or latent trajectory models) and cross-lagged panel models (i.e., panel vector autoregression) with random and fixed effects -- including the random intercept cross-lagged panel model (RI-CLPM) to assess time-varying and stable relationships. Short-run and long-run effects will be covered and methods for assessing them provided, as well as methods for mediation including bootstrapping and Bayesian analysis methods in blavaan. An official Instats certificate of completion is provided at the conclusion of the seminar.

https://instats.com/workshop_info/1651738159709x220035937550467070

Like all live Instats seminars, the seminar webpage has its own forum with 30 days of Q&A support and will include recordings of all livestreamed sessions so that you can participate asynchronously if you prefer.

As always, Instats offers discounts for PhD students and weekly Office Hours that provide free stats help for anyone who is interested! You can find all of Instats's offerings here, including additional structured programs and upcoming office hours by clicking their respective tab. 

Hope to see you soon!


Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
